content: You currently don't really have a definitive DPS, I'd recommend pulling for Mouchette
For the time being, can use Jenkins, Saya, Aigis and Cassiah
Optional to replace Casiah with Winkle for Weakness

Pollux/Winkle/Aigis/Saya.

If you have access to April’s Praise, I would personally prefer it over Crimson Pulse on Pollux. I would prefer Blade of the Titan on Pollux since you have E3 Winkle. 

Aigis can go Life Drain CoV with SSR Keyflare WoD and Elevated Focus.

Winkle WoDs can be Incalc Favor(from gacha) or Dusk and Dawn(from shop) for SSR. CoVs would ideally be Burial Grounds. The SR WoD can be Death Res or anything that helps her Exalt more often. 

Saya can run her Sig and any Death Res WoD or Sigil WoD. Saya CoV is Dreams of Medicine, or Burial Grounds.

For Posse, Pollux would be good, or you can always go for Miryaim.

Although I feel like your original team can work with more investment(specifically Pollux), and better WoDs + better CoVs. The issue I see is that you are all in on DMG, and have no way to survive via Weakness/Healing, and Shielding is meh in this team. It’s more the case that this team either nukes everything or runs out of fuel/lacks dmg and dies.
